text:
```yaml
name: Copilot Environment Setup

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  setup-environment:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Prepare Copilot Environment
        run: |
          echo "Preparing environment for Copilot Agent..."
          # Create a directory for environment artifacts if needed
          mkdir -p .copilot-env
          
          # Generate a lockfile snapshot or environment info for the agent
          npm ls --production --json > .copilot-env/dependencies.json
          
          # Optionally, cache node_modules for faster agent startup if supported by the agent runtime
          # This step ensures the environment is ready for the Copilot agent to utilize
          echo "Environment preparation complete."

      - name: Upload Environment Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: copilot-environment
          path: .copilot-env/
          retention-days: 1
```
